newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo central bank issues 100 dinar notes - agency.
newsitem.headline: Yugo central bank issues 100 dinar notes - agency.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) put into circulation new 100-dinar notes on Monday, the state news agency Tanjug reported.

The issue of the 100-dinar notes does not raise the amount of cash in circulation because existing worn and damaged notes of smaller denominations of the same total value will be withdrawn, Tanjug quoted an NBY statement as saying.
The highest note in circulation so far was 50 dinars. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
